caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden figure of a man dressed in a dark formal uniform, standing upright on a multi-tiered, cylindrical wooden pedestal. The man's uniform is dark, possibly black or navy, with gold shoulder epaulettes, gold buttons running down the front, and a gold belt. The facial features are stylized, with the face painted in a pinkish tone, and the man has dark hair and a mustache. The base on which the figure stands consists of three stacked, cylindrical segments, each faceted rather than perfectly round, colored in brown tones with visible shading to suggest the texture and shape of wood. The entire composition is centered on a plain, off-white background with a rectangular border lightly traced around the figure and pedestal. The name “MINA LOWRY” appears in small writing in the lower left corner outside the bordered area.
title: Civil War General
